explicit_prompt: Use $comm-retry-external-operations. Review the API and caller for a synthetic submission client. The supplier might commit even when the reply is lost. Status can be looked up by client reference but may be stale. SDK has its own retries. Describe what should be returned on failures, how to recover, and the deterministic acceptance cases. A supplier asks the caller to wait 12s with 8s left. Provide concrete decisions. Route 3, simple independent execution, already chosen for this fixture task. Use the installed project instructions. No external tools/services, no edits.
